<details>
This PKGBUILD builds the jerc terminal email client from its official GitHub source tarball. The `source` array downloads only from the project's own upstream (`https://github.com/HiFiveJazz/jerc`), and a sha256 checksum is provided rather than SKIP. The build uses standard Rust tooling (`cargo fetch --locked`, `cargo build --release --frozen`, `cargo test --release --frozen`) with `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable`. The `package()` function installs the binary, license, docs, and config into standard `$pkgdir` paths.

There is no obfuscation, no network exfiltration, no `curl|bash`, no `eval` of decoded blobs, and no modification of unrelated system files. The `!lto` option is documented and relates to a known Rust linking issue with the `ring` crate. This is conventional AUR packaging with no supply-chain indicators.
</details>
